question: 在短程任务（<3 步推理）中，Self-Refine 的第 1 轮反思带来约 10-15% 的准确率绝对提升，第 2 轮带来 3-5% 的提升，第 3 轮及以后边际增益 < 1%，符合指数衰减模型 p_N = p_inf - (p_inf - p_0)*e^(-kN)。

sources.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
sources.snippet: Like humans, large language models (LLMs) do not always generate the best output on their first try. Motivated by how humans refine their written text, we introduce Self-Refine, an approach for improving initial outputs from LLMs through iterative feedback and refinement.
